inputs.name: ReportImportService.constructor.repository
inputs.description: Optional repository instance used for imported records and passed to the selected adapter. Defaults to `new ReportRepository()`.

inputs.name: ReportImportService.ingest.format
inputs.description: Selects the import path: `playwright`, `vitest`, and `mira` use their adapters; `manual` and `command` use JSON handling. Other values are rejected as unsupported after the file is read and parsed.

inputs.name: ReportImportService.ingest.id
inputs.description: Identifier passed to the selected adapter or as the report argument to `repository.record`; this service does not validate or transform it.

inputs.name: ReportImportService.ingest.file
inputs.description: Import file path passed to an adapter or read as UTF-8 JSON. For manual evidence records, relative `data.path` values are resolved against this file's directory.

inputs.name: ReportImportService.ingest.findings
inputs.description: Optional string passed through to the Mira adapter; other formats do not use it. Defaults to `undefined`.
examples: Two checks failed during the import.

outputs.name: ReportImportService.ingest
outputs.type: Promise<{ checks: number; } | { evidence: number; } | { records: number; }>
outputs.description: Resolves to the selected adapter's result, `{records: number}` for a manual import, or `{checks: 1}` for a command import. This service does not define the adapters' result shapes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for unsupported formats, manual imports without a records array, command arrays, or when the numeric conversion of command `exitCode` is not an integer. File, adapter, and repository failures also propagate.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by `JSON.parse` when a non-adapter import file does not contain valid JSON.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Can be thrown by unchecked property access when parsed data or a manual record is null, or when an evidence record has a missing or null data object.
